summary: Read the entire 30-page paper and markdown conversion, including the appendix, and checked all 116 estimates against the cited PDF pages and the extraction rules. All 220 recorded arm levels, 44 sets of difference/t/p statistics, 11 prose p-value bounds, and recorded people counts match their printed sources. Found six Task 2 construct-coding errors and twelve omitted objective AUT recognition-accuracy contrasts for Days 2-7. No additional eligible contrast was found. The paper’s inconsistent follow-up statistics, outcome labels, and blanket significance notes should remain documented as source conflicts rather than be numerically repaired.
